false_negative_audits.original_supporting_evidence: UT San Antonio's mechanical registry row was not promoted in the bounded baseline, although current official pages establish a bachelor's-entry Computer Science PhD, Fall 2027 cycle, relevant AI and security context, and a comprehensive doctoral support package.

Manitoba's exact doctorate was absent from the original set despite current software-engineering and security fit, a rare direct-bachelor's exception, and a published four-year minimum doctoral funding policy.
